name: Fujima Innis
source:
Likes: Her father and her mother, playing with her twin sister [url=/c78798]Maha[/url] and her grandmother.

Inusu is the daughter of [url=/c44410]Ren[/url] and [url=/c33070]Arle[/url] whom they conceived shortly after their marriage and their settlement in Ancient Egypt (in the world of Demons). She is between 4 and 5 years old.

"We came with Grandma, having fun."
